data.pageStyle:
<style>
/* ===== Choose your new plan — brand accent #d72585 ===== */

/* Give the cards a little more room */
div.tw-grid.tw-auto-rows-fr {
  max-width: 1120px !important;
}

/* Primary action ("Upgrade") -> brand pink */
.tw-bg-primary {
  background-color: #d72585 !important;
}
.hover\:tw-bg-primary\/80:hover {
  background-color: #b51d6f !important;
}

/* Pink tints derived from the accent (badge + current-plan card) */
.tw-bg-primary\/10 { background-color: rgba(215, 37, 133, 0.12) !important; }
.tw-bg-primary\/5  { background-color: rgba(215, 37, 133, 0.05) !important; }

/* "Current plan" badge text */
.tw-bg-primary\/10.tw-text-text-secondary {
  color: #b51d6f !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

/* Make the current-plan card clearly the highlighted one */
[data-testid="cart-item"].tw-bg-primary\/5 {
  border-color: #d72585 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(215, 37, 133, 0.15) !important;
}

/* Subtle interactive lift on the cards */
[data-testid="cart-item"] {
  transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease !important;
}
[data-testid="cart-item"]:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10) !important;
}
</style>
